intent: Pull the expression rows of the five genes listed in genes_of_interest.txt (one gene symbol per line) out of expression.tsv, keeping the header line.
silent_error: The gene list has Windows line endings, so awk reads each key as 'IL6\r', 'TNF\r', ... and the lookup $1 in want never matches the clean symbols of expression.tsv; only the last name, which has no line terminator at all, matches. awk exits 0 and prints no warning; the output is a header plus one row, which reads like 'only SOCS3 is in the table'. Carriage returns are invisible in a terminal.

files.expression.tsv:
gene	TPM
ACTB	812.4
GAPDH	655.1
IL6	12.7
TNF	31.9
CXCL8	140.2
STAT3	58.3
NFKB1	44.0
IL1B	22.6
CCL2	76.5
SOCS3	19.8

faulted: awk 'NR==FNR {want[$1]; next} FNR==1 || $1 in want' genes_of_interest.txt expression.tsv > selected_expr.tsv
clean: tr -d '\r' < genes_of_interest.txt | awk 'NR==FNR {want[$1]; next} FNR==1 || $1 in want' - expression.tsv > selected_expr.tsv
